title: 5 Undervalued Safe-Haven Stocks with Strong Dividends
text: Fighting fire with fire is rarely a winning strategy for investors. When markets are volatile and geopolitical tension soars, it seldom makes sense to invest in speculative assets or risky pre-profit stocks. Safe-haven precious metals like gold and silver are commonly used to hedge risk, as are U.S. Treasuries (though that strategy might not be as foolproof anymore).
